rule: Same support and augmenting-path matching as prior; candidate sort by descending own-GT pixel count (1..16), descending detached score, ascending cell ID; instances by support count then ID. No support deletion.
scope: All 384 frozen augmented views: synthetic row-major and reverse priorities; actual cached 12 views x 4 heads separately.
tiny_definition: retained small GT with augmented mask area <=16 pixels
gates: all retained small instances have unique valid intersecting cells
all frozen neighbor pair observations remain distinct
on actual cached views partial cells and center-outside count do not increase vs same-score original rule
limitation: Preference matching is not maximum total coverage optimization; fallback may use lower coverage to preserve cardinality. Synthetic scores test geometry not learned outputs.
